
Load associated data

Get some summary statistics

```{r}

describe(renewable_shock_series %>% 
           select(wind_solar_tot, day_ahead_forecast, intraday_forecast, 
                  intraday_update_renewables, unpredicted_renewables ))
```



Plot the difference between the two graphs

```{r}
colnames(renewable_shock_series)
date_time_string <- "2021/01/01 00:00:00"

# Convert to POSIXct
posixct_date_time <- as.POSIXct(date_time_string, format = "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S")

date_time_string <- "2021/01/07 00:00:00"

# Convert to POSIXct
posixct_date_time2 <- as.POSIXct(date_time_string, format = "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S")


renewable_shock_first_week <- renewable_shock_series%>% 
  rename(datetime =`__index_level_0__`) %>% 
  filter(datetime < posixct_date_time2 & datetime > posixct_date_time )

my_plot <- ggplot(data =renewable_shock_first_week)+
  geom_line(aes(x =datetime , y = intraday_Solar, color="Intraday Solar")) +
geom_line(aes(x =datetime , y = Fore_Solar, color="Day Before Solar")) +
  geom_line(aes(x =datetime , y = intraday_Wind, color="Intraday Wind")) +
  geom_line(aes(x =datetime , y = Fore_Wind, color="Day Before Wind")) +
  labs(x= 'Electricity delivery date', y = "Difference between the two predictions", 
       title = "Intermittence uncertainty news shock") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Intraday Solar" = "darkblue", "Day Before Solar" = "blue", "Intraday Wind" = "darkgreen", "Day Before Wind" = "lightgreen")) +
  theme_minimal()

my_plot
```

```{r}
boxplot_data <- renewable_shock_series %>% 
  mutate(intraday_update_wind = intraday_Wind - Fore_Wind,
         intraday_update_solar =  intraday_Solar - Fore_Solar,
         year = year(`__index_level_0__`)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("intraday_update_"),
                                   names_to = "plant_type", 
                                   values_to = "Unexpected.Capacity") %>% 
  mutate(plant_type = ifelse(plant_type == "intraday_update_wind", "Wind", "Solar")) %>% 
  filter(year >2017)

plot1 <- ggplot(data = boxplot_data, aes(x = as.factor(year), y = Unexpected.Capacity, color = plant_type)) +
  # geom_bar(data = plot_data, aes(x = as.factor(year), y = min_Unexpected.Capacity, fill = plant_type), alpha=0.4, stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  # geom_bar(data = plot_data, aes(x = as.factor(year), y = max_Unexpected.Capacity, fill = plant_type), alpha=0.4, stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(x = 'Date de publication', y = "Unavailable Capacity") +
  theme_minimal()
plot1
```
